_comment: Shared mapping used by the four SDK reference doc generators (sdks/{python,typescript,go,ruby}/docs)
to emit the per-language overview pages at content/docs/reference/<lang>/index.mdx.
corePages: descriptions for the shared top-level reference pages. A language only lists the
core pages it actually emits (for example, only Go and TypeScript have an embedded page).
featureClients: one entry per canonical feature-client concept. 'slugs' maps each language to
the page slug under reference/<lang>/feature-clients/; a language is omitted when it has no
such client. 'guide' and 'guideTitle' point at the user-guide page for the feature (null when
no guide exists). Guide paths must be absolute and must exist under
Validation (enforced by every generator, which hard-fails on violation):
- every emitted feature-client page must have exactly one entry whose slug matches
- every entry with a slug for the language must match an emitted page (no stale entries)
- every non-null guide path must exist as a content file
agentDocs: shared content for the generated 'Documentation for agents' block each
generator injects into its package-manager-facing README (npm/PyPI/RubyGems) or, for Go,
into the package doc comment in sdks/go/hatchet.go. baseUrl + link path + '.md' is the
plain-markdown URL the docs site serves for each page. A link with a 'langs' array is
only rendered for those languages. Every link path must exist as a content file

agentDocs.lead: The linked pages serve plain markdown for tools and agents. Full docs index: https://docs.hatchet.run/llms.txt
